description: Two players: a survival player uses a carved pumpkin and a zombie head with nothing worn (neither goes on) and armor from her off hand, then stands before a dispenser that is given one item at a time and powered: a helmet goes on, a second helmet and an elytra over a chestplate are ejected, boots go on; each step's attributes, slot changes, sounds, level events, the items that appear and the other's view of her equipment; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
